title.zh: 与Claude Code协作实现快速开发
title.en: Working with Claude Code for Rapid Game Prototype

blurb.zh: 本文简述了个人快速搭建原型的工作流
blurb.en: This article introduces my personal workflow by using Claude in game development.

body.value:
STATIC BLOOM is a short atmospheric piece built around a single broken transmission. The player wanders a derelict observatory, tuning antennae to recover fragments of a forgotten broadcast.

Designed as a study in restraint: no HUD, no combat, no objectives beyond curiosity.

body.caption: The main observatory floor at dawn.

body.value: I built the entire vertical slice solo in Unity HDRP. Most of the time was spent on the audio: each antenna emits its own filtered noise that mixes into a single drifting drone, generated procedurally from FMOD events.

body.caption: Antenna tuning interaction — analog dial driven by player position.

body.value: Lessons learned: cut the inventory system on day three. The game got better the moment I stopped trying to give the player things to do.

title.zh: 简评《星露谷物语》中的能量条设计
title.en: A Quick Review of Energy bar design in Stardew Valley

blurb.zh: 一种巧妙调节玩家游玩节奏的方式
blurb.en: A sophisticated method of gently regulating the play's pace

value.zh: 在星露谷物语中，能量条（或称精力条）的存在在刚开始可能会让某些玩家感到困惑：为什么我感觉什么都没干只是砍了几下树，敲了几块石头就累倒了，还损失了五十块钱。又或者是，我今天明明还打算去一趟镇上的杂货铺，但是由于我缺少精力，只能睡一觉明天再说。甚至有的时候还会因为挣扎在晕倒的边缘而惊心动魄地祈祷自己能顺利在昏倒之前回到家里。
value.en: In Stardew Valley, the energy bar can be a source of confusion for some players when they first start playing: How am I already exhausted? It feels like I’ve barely done anything—just chopped down a few trees or broken a couple of rocks—and suddenly I collapse, losing 50 bucks in the process. Or perhaps I had planned to stop by the grocery store in town that day, only to realize that I simply didn't have enough energy left and would have to put it off until tomorrow. And if you know, you know: those nerve-racking moments when you're right on the edge of passing out, desperately hoping you'll make it back home before collapsing.

value.zh: 但由于星露谷物语精美可爱的美术视觉风格——一座悠闲的乡下童话小镇，配合放松的背景音乐，以及刚开始你确实没那么多需要操心的事情：只是种种防风草，顺便清理一下门口的杂草和树丛，或许拜访几个邻居。因此渐渐的，玩家会在心理上接受这种设定：那好吧，在这样一个一切看上去都很悠闲的地方，为什么我还要拼死拼活地劳作呢？精力不够那就上床睡觉，等待明天的到来。
value.en:
However, Stardew Valley's charming visual style—a cosy countryside fairytale town paired with relaxing background music—along with the fact that you really don't have much to worry about at the beginning, gradually changes the way players perceive this system. At first, your days mostly consist of watering a few parsnips, clearing some weeds and bushes outside your farmhouse, and maybe dropping by to visit a few neighbours around town.

Slowly but surely, players begin to accept the logic behind it: Alright then, in a place where everything feels so peaceful and laid-back, why should I be working myself to death like a 24/7 convenience store employee? If I run out of energy, so be it. I'll just head to bed and wait for tomorrow to arrive.

value.zh: 而这正是开发者们想要看到的。当玩家对这种慢悠悠的节奏逐渐适应后，他们就开始加快节奏了，你会收到各种信件和新任务，引导你一边探索星露谷里更丰富的设定和系统，一边让你扩大自己的版图。于是这时候玩家们会发现一天的时间很快变得不够用，我本该在睡前给作物浇水，结果挖了一天矿已经没力气了。于是，玩家会从此刻开始思考，想要变得更加高效只有两种方式：第一，在一天开始之前考虑好要处理的事项优先级，第二，如何提高我的精力条？
value.en:
And that's exactly what the developers want to see. Once players have settled into the game's slow and easy-going rhythm, the pace begins to pick up. New letters arrive in the mailbox, new quests appear, and the game gradually encourages you to both explore the richer systems and stories hidden throughout Stardew Valley and expand your own little corner of it.

Before long, players begin to realise that a single day suddenly doesn't feel nearly long enough anymore. I was supposed to water my crops before bed, but after spending the entire day mining, I'm already out of energy.

And it is at this moment that players begin to think that there are only two ways to become more efficient: first, decide what deserves priority before the day even begins; second, figure out how to make that energy bar last longer.

value.zh: 答案当然是：两者皆可！而这正是开发者们喜闻乐见的。当你开始自发地产生脑内路线规划，并且给排列出今日要做的任务和优先级时，你就已经学会了自己去探索和自主驱动地在这个游戏里探索，而不是通过开发者为你塞进来一封又一封邮件，或者给你整个琳琅满目的任务系统。而当你开始想办法提高精力条的上限或者恢复精力条时，你开始把精力条当作游戏里的一种资源，而你此时产生了一个新的重要目标：我需要升级，以及，我需要合成/获取更多能恢复精力的道具。
value.en:
The answer, of course, is: both. And once again, that's exactly what the developers want to see.

The moment you start mentally mapping out your own routes for the day and arranging your tasks according to priority, you've already learned to explore the game on your own terms and drive your own progress, rather than relying on an endless stream of letters in your mailbox or a giant checklist of quests handed to you by the developers.

And when you begin looking for ways to increase your maximum energy or restore it more efficiently, the energy bar stops being a restriction and starts becoming a resource in its own right. At that point, a new set of goals naturally emerges: I need upgrades. And I need better tools, foods, and items that can keep my energy topped up.

value.zh: 所以，我会将星露谷物语里的精力条设计定义为一个优秀的案例，即如何通过设置某种限制，反而促进玩家的自驱力，让游戏里的目标和任务自发地涌现。其实很多游戏中都有类似的设定存在，在某些策略游戏中，这种设计被包装成行动点数；或者某些内置购买的游戏则是直接将这种行动点设定成了可以通过花钱补充的资源；而在很多战斗游戏中，尽管你的行为不会直接消耗，但是你的生命值经常受到威胁从而需要进行维护。只是为何星露谷物语中的这个设计会让玩家产生新鲜感，我认为主要有以下几点原因。
value.en:
To sum it up, I would consider the energy bar in Stardew Valley an excellent example of game design: a system where imposing limitations on the player actually encourages self-motivation, allowing goals and tasks to emerge naturally rather than being explicitly assigned by the game itself.

In fact, similar ideas can be found in many other games. In some strategy games, this limitation takes the form of action points. In certain free-to-play titles, those action points are even turned into a monetisable resource that can be replenished with real money. And in many combat-focused games, while your actions may not directly consume a resource, your health is constantly under threat and therefore requires careful management.

So why does Stardew Valley's implementation of this idea feel so fresh to players? I believe there are several reasons for that.

value.zh:
1. 精力条的可视化方法并不会直接告诉你某个行为将会消耗多少能量，真的没有多少玩家喜欢在游戏里看见大量数字！（当然，某些爱好爆炸式数值呈现的玩家除外）而这种选择性的不可视也让玩家体验上更加自由，这是一种心理影响。
2. 与模拟经营游戏的结合。正如这篇简评一开始提到的，这是一种巧妙控制游玩节奏的策略。由于精力条的存在，你不能再像个永动机一样昼夜不停地在你的模拟农场里劳作，而是每一天都需要思考今天将要探索哪几个地点，做些什么。也会让你格外期待下一天的到来，因为你有很多来不及今天完成的事情。而这种强制中断未尽之事的心理体验会让人上瘾，不像那些不加限制的经营游戏，当你持续不断工作了几个小时之后，大部分玩家会开始感到疲惫，而当你因为疲惫退出游戏后，下一次打开可能就是很久之后了。但这种强迫你中止的循环会让玩家不断地想起那些还没有完成的事情，从而因为这短暂的停止而更加投入到下一次循环中。
value.en:
1. The energy bar never tells you the numbers.

First of all, the game never directly tells you how much energy each action costs. And honestly, most players don't actually enjoy staring at a bunch of numbers while playing games. (Well, unless you're one of those people who get excited by damage numbers exploding all over the screen.)

By keeping some of that information hidden, the game actually makes the whole system feel less restrictive. You're not constantly calculating whether chopping down one more tree will cost 6 energy or 8 energy. You just get a rough feeling for it over time.

Ironically, making the system less visible makes players feel more free, even though the restriction itself never disappeared. That's the psychological trick behind it.

2. It works perfectly with the farming sim genre.

As I mentioned at the beginning, this is a very clever way of controlling the pace of the game.

Because of the energy bar, you can't just turn yourself into some kind of farming machine that works 24 hours a day without stopping. Every morning you naturally start asking yourself:

"Am I going mining today?"

"Should I spend the day fishing?"

"Do I finally have time to upgrade my pickaxe?"

Suddenly, planning becomes part of the game.

And perhaps more importantly, the game makes you excited for tomorrow.

There's always something you didn't get around to doing today. Maybe the crops still need watering. Maybe there's another five floors waiting for you in the mines. Maybe you were this close to finally catching that fish.

And strangely enough, being forced to stop is exactly what makes you want to keep playing.

In a lot of management games with no restrictions, players simply keep going until they burn themselves out. A few hours later they're tired, they quit, and the next time they open the game might be weeks later.

Stardew Valley does the opposite.

It stops you while you're still thinking:

"Ah, just one more day."

And because the game leaves things unfinished, those unfinished tasks stay in your head. You keep thinking about them after you've stopped playing, which only makes you more excited to jump back in next time.

value.zh: 总结，星露谷物语中的精力条设计不仅本身成为了一种独特的游戏体验，还与游戏任务系统和养成系统进行了有机结合。这是一种非常聪明且基于玩家体验出发的游戏设计思路。
value.en: To sum up, the energy bar in Stardew Valley is not only a unique gameplay experience in itself, but also one that blends seamlessly with the game's quest and progression systems. It is a remarkably clever design, built around the player experience from beginning to end.

title.zh: 时隔13年，我们可以从黑色洛城中学习到什么
title.en: Thirteen Years Later: What Can We Learn from L.A. Noire?

blurb.zh: 他们是如何构建出一座有血有肉的40s罪恶都市洛城？——有选择的细节决定真实性塑造。
blurb.en: How did they build a vibrant, living 1940s crime-ridden city in L.A. Noire? — The choice of details shapes the sense of realism.

value.zh: 作者标注：此篇为早期完成。
value.en: Notice: This is an early article.

value.zh: NPC微表情：使用自研的加强版面部捕捉技术应用到NPC的微表情，可以通过观察NPC的微表情来判断他们是否说谎。我不敢说直到现在这项技术是否已经被广泛应用，但对于十三年前来说，这样一款能够捕捉到人物细致入微的表情，其真实感和流畅度仍然是足以令人震惊的。这里也不得不佩服R星工作室的开发者们为之付出的心血，在幕后访谈中，开发者提到他们使用了360度无死角的摄像头来捕捉每一个动作乃至表情的细节，而这对于设计者来说也同样是一项复杂的工作：他们做到了给每一位NPC设计好各种表情的细节，坦然、犹豫、惊慌、嘲讽......这些表情的含义相似但不同演员的表演却带来了毫无重复的新鲜感，因此在游戏中，当你与这些或许配合或许抗拒的人物进行对峙时，除了利用好手上收集到的线索和他们的表述，很多时候更加好用的是这些近乎真实的微表情判断——而作为玩家，我是第一次在游戏中如此细致入微地观察一个由电脑程序控制的NPC的表情，仿佛我穿过屏幕化身此地，而我所面对的都是一个个鲜活真实，生活在这座混乱邪恶的洛城里的 人。
value.en: NPC Micro-Expressions: The game uses a self-developed advanced facial capture technology to depict NPCs’ micro-expressions. These expressions allow players to assess whether someone is lying. While I can’t say if this technology is widely used today, it was still incredibly impressive for its time. Thirteen years ago, the ability to capture such subtle facial expressions added a level of realism and smoothness that was truly astonishing. The developers at Rockstar Studios deserve immense credit for the effort they put in. In behind-the-scenes interviews, they mentioned using 360-degree cameras to capture every detail of movements and expressions. This was a complex task for the designers, as they had to create a variety of facial expressions for each NPC—calm, hesitation, panic, sarcasm… Although these expressions might have similar meanings, different actors’ performances brought freshness and uniqueness to each one. In the game, when confronting these characters—whether cooperative or resistant—it’s often more useful to rely on these almost lifelike micro-expressions, rather than just the clues or statements you’ve gathered. For me, as a player, this was the first time I observed NPCs controlled by a computer program so closely, as though I had stepped through the screen into the city, facing real people who lived in the chaotic, evil world of Los Angeles.

value.zh: 出色的音效设计与游戏情节相结合：游戏音乐设计主要由两大部分组成：背景音乐和音效。黑色洛城的背景音乐选取了几首十分经典的爵士乐以及当时在美国流行的乡村音乐。这些音乐非常适合游戏的故事背景——1940年代的美国洛杉矶，流行之都，并且很好地为游戏注入了类似电影般的体验，配合这些经典的音乐，在洛城里开车办案，无疑是一种享受。而游戏里我最喜欢的一首ost是进入游戏主界面时播放的爵士，配合红色霓虹灯管闪烁着L.A.，映入眼帘的是黑白配色的游戏界面，在一面小巷晦暗的墙面上投射出的光影构成了几个选项字体，这一切完美地展现了游戏的气质——疑云重重的案件，纸醉金迷的40年代洛杉矶生活，这种阴冷夹杂着欲望的气息，足以称之为是一个吸引人的开场。其次，游戏的音效设计同样出色。在游戏过程中，当你在与人审问的过程中选择了错误的判断，游戏会响起一段沉重的音乐，这种音效加大了玩家在游戏体验过程中的不安感。
value.en: Outstanding Sound Design Combined with Storytelling: The game’s music is split into two main categories: background music and sound effects. L.A. Noire uses several classic jazz tracks and popular country music from the 1940s in Los Angeles, which perfectly fit the setting of the game. These tracks inject a cinematic experience into the gameplay. One of my favorite OSTs is the jazz song that plays when you enter the main menu, accompanied by the neon red “L.A.” lights and the black-and-white interface. The shadowed alley wall projecting light and text options is a perfect representation of the game’s atmosphere—filled with mystery and the decadence of 1940s Los Angeles, creating an enticing opening. The sound effects are equally excellent. For example, when you make a wrong judgment during an interrogation, a heavy, ominous tune plays, increasing the player’s sense of unease during the experience.

value.zh: 细节且风味足够的人物对话设计——还原真实的城市风土一向是R星的拿手好戏，除了那些在GTA中随处可见的障碍物破坏、会从车上跳下来大声指责你的司机们、当你违规驾驶时四处惊慌逃窜路人，你甚至可以通过警察们在车上的闲聊窥见90s的洛杉矶文化。而在紧张刺激的追逐中，那些看似无关紧要只是程序生成的与你擦肩而过的路人却会停下脚步为你加油助威，同样，在这座看热闹不嫌事大的城市里，当你前往证人的家中进行搜查审讯时，在门口遇见的一帮游手好闲的混混可能会对你毫不掩饰地流露他们对于警察的厌恶。这些与主线任务无关紧要的台词设计，却为玩家还原呈现出一个立体鲜活的黑色洛城，相信你即便不赶去案发现场，慢悠悠地开着车在城市里晃荡，听着身旁除了唠嗑几乎毫无用处的搭档的闲聊和车载的经典音乐，看着街道两旁的城市风景以及时不时会路过一些经典的地标建筑，也是十分惬意的。
value.en: Detailed and Flavorful Dialogue Design: Rockstar is known for faithfully recreating city cultures, and L.A. Noire is no exception. Apart from the usual obstacles and car chases, you can even hear police officers casually chatting in their cars about 90s LA culture. In intense chases, the seemingly irrelevant pedestrians you pass by may stop to cheer you on. On the other hand, when visiting a witness’s house for an interrogation, you might encounter idle thugs who openly express their disdain for the police. These seemingly minor, unrelated lines of dialogue add richness to the world and create a vivid, three-dimensional city. Even if you’re not rushing to the crime scene, casually driving through the city, listening to your partner’s chatter or the classic in-car music, while taking in the cityscape and passing landmarks, is quite relaxing.

value.zh: 出色的推理玩法与动作设计——枪战、飙车、收集线索、审讯犯人、盘问证人、紧张的追逐战等等，被恰到好处地安排设计，游玩体验就像观看一部美国经典犯罪电影那样爽快刺激，环环相扣的案件推进丝毫不会让人感到疲惫。在前期的任务中，即便我们在审问的过程中屡屡失误错失机会，也几乎不会影响我们逐步解锁新地点，只不过会使这个过程变得较为缓慢。而每一次案件我们都将经历从前期的取证、搜查、使用线索进行审问，这也是黑色洛城的核心玩法。但是，很显然设计师们并没有止步于此，为了尽可能还原在一座凶险的罪恶都市的警探生涯，也为了游戏的层次更加丰富，除此之外，枪战、飙车、追逐战、甚至在执勤的路上偶遇抢劫犯人的突发事件，都毫无疑问将游戏的真实体验感再度提升一个档次。
value.en: Brilliant Detective Work and Action Design: Gunfights, car chases, collecting clues, interrogating criminals, questioning witnesses, and thrilling pursuits are all seamlessly integrated, creating a play experience that feels as engaging and intense as watching a classic American crime movie. The investigations unfold logically without overwhelming the player. Early on, even if we make mistakes during interrogations, we can still unlock new locations, though the process may be slower. Each case involves evidence collection, searches, and questioning based on clues—this is the core gameplay of L.A. Noire. However, the designers didn’t stop there. They added extra layers of depth, such as gunfights, car chases, and even random events like encountering a robbery while on patrol, all of which elevate the immersion.

value.zh:
本作如何在有限的框架下提供自由的选择？——沉浸式电影般的体验
一个特殊的点：在可以自由驾车探索真实还原洛城风貌的地图上，并非一举一动都是完全开放自由的。但这种限制却是必不可少——当玩家作为警探要尝试通过收集线索来一点点缩小调查范围，过于宽泛的选择并不是一件好事，试想一下，假如你像在辐射4中那样每一件物品都可以捡起观察，是不是足以令人头大？而LANoire选择在一个有限的空间内设置一定数量的clue spot，并且结合足够的音效和画面提示来帮助玩家找到线索，当你没有头绪时，除了查看随身携带的小笔记本，甚至还可以询问身旁的搭档是否有建议。这种将探索的自由和筛选线索的限制平衡得非常好，令玩家在对每一个调查现场感到足够好奇和兴奋的同时，也不会因为混乱的交互物品而感到烦躁。
其次：笔记本的定位和线索梳理功能。游戏里主角最重要的道具除了汽车大概就是这个随身携带的调查笔记本。我认为这是游戏中一个很实用而且巧妙的小设计，面对一个真实还原的大地图和数量繁多的细节线索，我不认为追求真实地要求玩家全靠自己来记住是合理的，很大概率上这只会让玩家感到烦躁和困难，从而无法游玩下去。而拥有了这个小笔记本，可以自动将玩家收集到的关键线索记录下来，作为之后审问犯人的根据，还可以根据线索和证词圈定几个需要调查的关键地点，而且可以在地图上自动标记。这些功能减少了游戏为了真实性带来的潜在困难，大大提升了玩家的游戏体验。
value.en:
**How Does the Game Provide Freedom Within a Limited Framework? — Immersive Cinematic Experience**: A notable aspect of *L.A. Noire* is its open world map where players can freely explore and experience a realistic version of Los Angeles. However, not all actions are completely open and free, and this limitation is crucial. As a detective, narrowing down your investigation through clue collection requires focus. Imagine if the game let you pick up every item like in *Fallout 4*—it would be overwhelming. Instead, *L.A. Noire* cleverly restricts the number of clue spots within a defined space and provides helpful audio and visual cues to guide players. When you’re stuck, you can refer to your notebook or ask your partner for suggestions. This balance between free exploration and focused clue selection helps maintain excitement while preventing frustration from an overabundance of items.

**The Notebook and Clue Organization**: The protagonist’s most important tool besides their car is the investigation notebook. This is a very useful and clever feature. With such a large map and numerous clues, expecting players to remember everything would likely be frustrating. The notebook automatically records key clues, which can then be used to guide interrogations and pinpoint essential locations on the map. This feature alleviates potential issues caused by realism, enhancing the overall player experience.

value.zh:
游戏叙事的大成之作——并非单纯平铺直叙，而是有一个个看似无关的支线与穿插其中的回忆CG逐步塑造起一个多面有深度的主角。
有几个重要的点：
将场景和剧情结合得很好，没有多余的物品和场景设计，甚至不可交互的装饰性物品都暗示了一部分角色信息以及剧情发展。
每一段剧情的发展总有小转折带给玩家预料之外的感受。
优秀的台词设计。不管是与核心玩法无关的台词还是人物的关键证词，R星的设计做到了人物台词都能对应其角色设定，起到丰满人物形象的作用。尤其是每一次审问证人的对话，NPC的每一句台词都能做到既符合剧情和角色特点，且能够在不显得过分直白和愚蠢的前提下露出破绽——从而留给玩家根据调查得来的线索进行侦破。
在基于真实的社会和历史背景下进行剧情设计。
value.en:
**Masterful Narrative Design**: The story is not told in a linear, flat manner. Instead, seemingly unrelated side stories and inserted memory cutscenes gradually build a multi-faceted and deep protagonist. Several key points stand out:

- The integration of scenes and plot, with no unnecessary items or designs. Even non-interactive decorative items subtly hint at character backstory and plot developments.
- Every plot segment has small twists that keep the player engaged.
- The excellent dialogue design—whether it’s casual, unrelated lines or key testimonies, the dialogue always fits the character, enhancing their depth. Especially during interrogations, the NPCs’ lines fit both the storyline and character traits, revealing subtle clues without being too obvious, leaving room for players to piece together the investigation.

value.zh:
最后聊一下黑色洛城的小缺点：
首先，升级系统的意义不大。这几乎是完全可以在游玩途中被忽略的一个要素。除了解锁一些提示点数和新的人物制服，似乎并不能给我带来更多的驱动去升级解锁。比起这些升级带来的奖励，游戏吸引我玩下去的主要原因还是其优秀的剧情设计和独特的调查玩法。当然，这并不会构成一个减分项，只是说存在的意义没有那么大。
其次，不可避免的，质量略低的模型和画质似乎与细腻的微表情有时候配合得不是很好。考虑到黑色洛城的开发日期，这是完全可以理解的。但以一个2024年的玩家的角度来看，这种真实捕捉的面部表情有时候会在粗糙的模型上显得有些”恐怖“。
总体而言，黑色洛城毫无疑问是一款瑕不掩瑜的优秀作品，而且最难能可贵的是它独特的调查玩法至今仍然难以见到雷同的设计，这使得它在此类侦探游戏上留下了值得被铭记的一笔。
value.en:
**Final Thoughts on Minor Flaws**:

- The upgrade system feels insignificant. This is an aspect of the game that can almost be ignored. Aside from unlocking some hint points and new outfits for characters, the rewards don’t provide enough motivation for upgrading. The main draw of the game for me was its exceptional story design and unique investigative gameplay, rather than the upgrades themselves. Of course, this doesn’t detract from the overall experience.
- The low-quality models and graphics sometimes clash with the detailed micro-expressions. Given the game’s development date, this is understandable, but from a 2024 player’s perspective, the real-time facial capture can sometimes look a bit “creepy” on rougher models.

Overall, *L.A. Noire* is undeniably an excellent work with minor flaws that do not diminish its value. Its unique investigative gameplay remains unmatched, leaving a lasting impact on detective games and making it a standout in its genre.

- 核心系统

1. 互动系统

游戏中的主要互动方式是基于点击的，并且在特殊关卡中具有独特的互动机制。

游戏世界中的物品可以分为*可互动*和*不可互动*两类。角色根据场景中的时间和地点会有不同的对话选项。游戏中所有可收集的物品都被视为道具；除了代码扫描器外，所有其他道具仅在单一关卡中使用，并且使用后会被消耗。

- 设计目标：

1. 通过建立故事背景和提供线索来增强沉浸感。
2. 作为主要的进程推进方式，通过与角色和场景互动来完成任务目标，从而推动关卡进展。
value.en:
- Core Systems

1. Interaction System

The primary interaction method in the game is click-based, with unique interaction mechanics for special levels.

Items in the game world can be divided into *interactable* and *non-interactable*. Characters have different dialogue options depending on the time and location within the scene. All collectible items in the game are considered props; except for the code scanner, all other props are used in single levels and are consumed after use.

- Design Objectives:

1. Enhance immersion by establishing the story setting and providing clues.
2. Serve as the main progression method, advancing levels by interacting with characters and scenes to complete mission objectives.

value.zh:
- 相关系统

对话系统、道具系统、任务系统

- 游戏规则

游戏中的互动可以分为标准互动和非标准互动。

标准互动:

这些互动通过在场景中的可互动区域或角色上左键点击触发。

1. 只有点击可互动区域时，才会触发互动。不可互动区域不会有任何反应。
2. 当点击一个可互动区域（如场景中的某个部分或角色）时，摄像机会自动聚焦该区域。此时玩家可以点击特定物品进行进一步互动，或弹出详细信息。

非标准互动：主要发生在特殊关卡或场景中，包括扫描、切割、听音辨位和射击。

1. 扫描：代码扫描器在游戏中的多个部分都有使用。玩家可以通过点击物品栏中的扫描器来激活它。一旦启用，扫描器会持续开启，并在对准带有隐藏代码的表面时显示文字。例如，在逃离货舱的关卡中，扫描器能显示地板上的血迹，或者在接近时显示小马的位置。在婴儿关卡部分，扫描器也用于定位小马。
2. 切割：游戏中有两次出现切割机制。第一次是在生日庆祝关卡，玩家使用刀子通过按W和S键来切蛋糕。第二次是在船长关卡中，切割机制以相同的方式使用。
3. 听音辨位：在逃离货舱的关卡中，玩家需要通过听小马的声音来判断它是否靠近。当小马足够接近时，玩家将无法再继续移动。
4. 射击：在与斯旺西的对抗中，当斯旺西出现时，玩家需要射击三次才能逃脱。

- 游戏入口点

标准互动：标准互动没有特定的入口点。在整个游戏中，每个场景都有可以通过点击与之互动的区域和角色。

非标准互动：
 
1. 扫描：代码扫描器在第一个任务中被引入。玩家接受任务后，必须前往船长办公室并从储物柜中取出扫描器，加入物品栏。要使用它，玩家需要从物品栏中选择扫描器，点击激活，然后关闭物品栏。一旦激活，扫描器会默认保持开启状态，玩家可以用它来揭示表面上的隐藏代码。
value.en:
- Related Systems

Dialogue System, Item System, Mission System

- Gameplay Rules

The gameplay interactions can be divided into Standard Interactions and Non-Standard Interactions.

Standard Interactions: 

These are triggered by left-clicking on interactive areas or characters in the scene.

1. Interactions are only triggered when you click on an interactive area. Non-interactive areas will not react.
2. Once you click an interactive area (such as a part of the scene or a character), the camera will automatically zoom in on that area. You can then either click on specific items for further interaction or have detailed information pop up.

Non-Standard Interactions: These occur primarily in special levels or scenes and include scanning, cutting, listening for sound cues, and shooting.

1. Scanning: The code scanner is used in various parts of the game. The player can activate the scanner from the inventory by clicking on it. Once enabled, the scanner will continuously stay on, and when aimed at surfaces with hidden codes, it will display text. For example, in the escape the cargo hold level, the scanner reveals bloodstains on the floor or shows the location of the small pony when it gets close. In the baby-level section, the scanner is used to locate the small pony as well.
2. Cutting: This appears twice in the game. First, during the birthday celebration level, the player uses a knife to cut the cake by pressing the W and S keys to move back and forth. The second instance happens in the captain’s level, where the cutting mechanic is used in the same way.
3. Listening for Sound Cues: In the escape the cargo hold level, the player needs to listen for the small pony’s sounds to determine if it’s getting closer. When the pony is sufficiently near, the player cannot move any further.
4. Shooting: During the confrontation with Swansea, the player must shoot three times to escape when Swansea appears.

- Gameplay Entry Points

Standard Interactions: There are no specific entry points for standard interactions. Throughout the entire game, every scene contains areas and characters that can be interacted with by clicking.

Non-Standard Interactions:

1. Scanning: The code scanner is introduced in the first mission. After receiving the mission, the player must go to the captain’s office and retrieve the scanner from a storage cabinet to add it to the inventory. To use it, the player selects it from the inventory, clicks to activate, and then closes the inventory. Once active, the scanner will remain on by default, and the player can use it to reveal hidden codes on surfaces.

In this new setting, a chase sequence with Swansea unfolds. The player must shoot at Swansea when he appears, and hitting him three times will allow the player to proceed.

- 游戏界面

以下几种情况会出现不同的界面：点击互动、详细互动、角色互动、物品栏。

1. 点击互动：

可以点击的物品在互动后会直接显示详细描述。每个互动区域都有预设的固定视角供玩家查看。此外，当玩家接近一个互动区域时，会出现点击提示。不可互动的区域不会显示任何提示。

- Gameplay Interface

The following cases will show different interface: click interaction, detailed interaction, character interaction, inventory.

1. Click Interaction:

Items that can be clicked will directly show detailed descriptions once interacted with. Each interactive area has a pre-set, fixed camera angle for viewing. Additionally, when the player gets close to an interactive area, a click prompt will appear. Non-interactive areas won’t display any prompts.

value.zh:
2. 标准互动：

这些包括像开门、使用物品等动作。
value.en:
2. Standard Interactions:

3. 详细互动：

点击一个互动区域会触发动画，并使摄像机缩放到该区域的特写镜头。这使玩家能够专注于该区域的特定细节或物体，通过动画和摄像机角度的调整提供更多的背景或信息。

3. Detailed Interaction:

Clicking on an interactive area triggers an animation and zooms in the camera to display a close-up of the scene. This allows the player to focus on specific details or objects within that area, providing more context or information through the animation and camera angle adjustment.

4. Character Interaction:

Clicking on a character in the scene will zoom in the camera and open a dialogue box. Sometimes, this interaction will trigger an animation to further enhance the scene or the conversation.

5. Inventory:

Press Tab to open the inventory. Use the A and D keys to scroll through the items. Left-click to select an item. The item’s details will appear, along with a pop-up option asking whether you want to use it.

- The item model rotates 360 degrees to showcase its details.
- In the center of the screen, options for using or interacting with the item will appear.
- The item’s name and a detailed description will be shown at the bottom of the screen.

- 游戏循环

1. 主循环：剧情场景和关卡交替进行。

这款线性叙事游戏的游戏体验在很大程度上依赖于故事的节奏。游戏展示了一个平衡良好的节奏，使玩家在保持专注的同时，始终沉浸于剧情之中，同时通过充满挑战性和刺激性的关卡避免玩家感到无聊。关卡和剧情片段之间的过渡设计独特，既不突兀也不打断节奏，增强了游戏的整体艺术效果。整个过程中，现实场景与梦幻般扭曲的设置交替出现，给玩家提供了一种既熟悉又耳目一新的视觉体验。以下是一个简单的流程图，展示了游戏中船长视角的这一节奏片段：
value.en:
- Game Loop

1. Main Loop: Plot scenes and levels alternate.

The gameplay experience of this linear narrative game heavily depends on the pacing of the story. This game demonstrates a well-balanced rhythm that keeps players engaged in the story while maintaining their focus with thrilling, challenging levels, preventing boredom. The transition between levels and plot segments is uniquely designed, neither abrupt nor disruptive, enhancing the overall artistic effect of the game. Throughout, realistic scenes alternate with dreamlike, distorted settings, offering players a familiar yet refreshing visual experience. The following is a simple flowchart that represents this rhythm using a segment from the captain’s perspective in the game:

caption.zh: 另一个例子是在游戏接近尾声时，吉米意识到自己的错误时，快速的意识流闪回场景
caption.en: Another example is the quick stream of consciousness flashback near the end of the game, when Jimmy realizes his mistake

value.zh:
2. 次要循环：叙事（角色视角切换）、游戏内（节奏、能力限制）

游戏中的次要循环主要分为叙事部分和游戏体验部分。

- 叙事部分：

尽管游戏遵循线性叙事，但故事的节奏打破了时间线和主要视角的顺序。在某些章节中，部分事实故意被隐藏，直到故事的结尾才向玩家揭示，从而提供了一种不枯燥的叙事体验。视角在两个角色之间切换：船长和吉米，他们是整个故事的核心人物。船长的角色设计尤其有趣——在大部分游戏过程中（事故发生后），他基本上是一个躺在病床上的没有生命的角色，除了痛苦的挣扎外，无法做任何事情，唯一的动作就是他的眼睛。

玩家主要扮演吉米的角色，吉米是这一切的制造者。作为一个不断隐藏自己错误的罪人，吉米（玩家）必须忍受船长眼睛痛苦的凝视，这双眼睛不断地注视着他（评判他）。在某种程度上，船长后来的角色就像一个沉默的法官——唯一知道真相的人，默默见证吉米的虚伪和“承担责任”。

以下是一个简单的流程图，展示了游戏叙事时间线的变化：
value.en:
2. Minor Loop: Narrative (Character Perspective Shift), In-Game (Pacing, Ability Limitations)

The minor loop in the game is primarily divided into the narrative section and the gameplay experience section.

- Narrative Section:

Although the game follows a linear narrative, the pacing of the story disrupts the timeline and main perspective. In certain chapters, some facts are intentionally withheld, only to be revealed to the player at the end of the story, offering a non-boring narrative experience. The perspective switches between only two characters: the captain and Jimmy, who are the core characters of the entire story. The captain’s character design is particularly interesting—during most of the game (after the accident), he is essentially a lifeless figure lying on a hospital bed, unable to do anything except painfully struggle, with the only movement being his eye.

The player predominantly takes on the role of Jimmy, the one who caused all of this. As a sinner who continuously hides his mistakes, Jimmy (the player) must endure the painful gaze of the captain’s eye, which constantly watches him (judges him). In a sense, the captain’s later role is like a silent judge — the only one who knows the truth, silently witnessing Jimmy’s hypocrisy and “taking on responsibility.”

The following is a simple flowchart that illustrates the change in the narrative timeline of the game:

value.zh: 这种叙事结构直接的效果就是让玩家对眼前的局势感到困惑，但正是这种困惑驱使着玩家继续游戏，充满了问题和好奇心，渴望揭开真相。同时，两个叙事线条常常是相互依赖的，让玩家在体验“顿悟时刻”的同时，又产生了新的问题，形成了一个节奏良好的叙事循环。
value.en: This narrative structure has the most direct effect of leaving players confused by the situation in front of them, but this confusion is precisely what drives them to continue playing, filled with questions and curiosity to uncover the truth. At the same time, the two narrative threads are often interdependent, allowing players to experience the “aha moment” while simultaneously acquiring new questions, creating a well-paced narrative loop.

value.zh:
- 总结

《缄默货运》是叙事驱动游戏中的一部杰作。它真正卓越之处在于，许多叙事型游戏在看完视频攻略后会失去吸引力，而在重新游玩时体验往往会减弱。然而，即使看完完整的游戏并了解剧情，我在亲自游玩时依然感到这款游戏极具冲击力。我认为，主要原因在于其出色的氛围（包括音效设计、环境艺术、光照效果，甚至过渡）和其卓越的故事叙述节奏，真相逐渐展开，一点一滴地揭示。

游戏同样遵循了经典的恐怖游戏原则之一：恐惧通常来自火力的匮乏。也就是说，除了营造氛围外，适度限制玩家的能力实际上能够增强感官效果，从而带来更加刺激和悬疑的体验。此外，游戏在管理心理恐怖的节奏方面表现得尤为出色。例如，在逃离货舱的过程中，安静的背景音和小马逐渐接近的情节制造了持续的紧张感，保持了玩家的警觉性，增强了他们的情绪波动，使其进入深度专注和流畅的状态。我特别欣赏的一个设计元素是管道部分，玩家只能后退。当他们慢慢退后时，心中不断担心会遇到什么奇怪的东西。与此同时，他们注意到管道上贴着“责任”这个词，增添了更深层次的情感冲击，并留下了深刻的印象。

游戏的系统并不特别复杂，这也让我在分析其系统时遇到了一定困难。但这款游戏给了我一个重要的启示：有时候，一款游戏不需要更多复杂的系统来增加乐趣。通过精简不必要的细节，专注于主题，学会简化，依然可以创造出一款优秀的游戏。
value.en:
- Summary

Mouthwashing is a masterpiece of narrative-driven games. What makes it truly remarkable is that many narrative games lose their appeal after watching the video walkthrough, and the experience can often feel diminished when replayed. However, even after watching the full gameplay and knowing the plot, I still found the experience incredibly impactful when I played it myself. The main reason for this, I believe, lies in its outstanding atmosphere (including sound design, environment art, lighting effects, even transitions), and its exceptional pacing in storytelling, where the truth gradually unfolds, piece by piece.

The game also adheres to a classic principle in horror games: fear often comes from a lack of firepower. That is, in addition to creating an atmosphere, limiting the player’s abilities to a certain extent actually enhances sensory effects, resulting in a more thrilling and suspenseful experience. Furthermore, the game excels in managing the pacing of psychological horror. For instance, in the escape from the cargo hold, the quiet moments and the gradual approach of the creature, Little Horse, create a constant tension, keeping the player on edge and heightening their emotional fluctuations, reaching a state of deep focus and flow. One particular design element I really appreciate is the segment in the pipes, where the player can only move backward. As they slowly retreat, there’s a constant worry about encountering something strange. At the same time, they notice the word “Responsibility” posted on the pipe, which adds a deeper level of emotional impact and leaves a strong impression.

The game’s systems are not particularly complex, which made it difficult to apply the methods I learned during my internship when analyzing its systems. But this game has taught me an important lesson: sometimes, a game doesn’t need more complex systems to be more enjoyable. By trimming unnecessary details, focusing on the theme, and learning to simplify, you can still create a great game.

title.zh: 混合现实？虚拟现实？哪个更好？
title.en: Mixed Reality? Virtual Reality? Which one better?

blurb.zh: 基于Unity的MR+VR叙事游戏设计与思考
blurb.en: MR+VR Narrative Game design thinking (based on Unity)

genre.zh: MR, VR, 叙事, 教育

value.zh:
这个项目本身是我大学本科期间的一个思考，当时要为导师设计并开发一个教育游戏，初步选定了虚拟现实技术作为项目研究方向。在前期调查的过程中，我发现混合现实（MR）和虚拟现实（VR）存在以下微妙的区分：
1. MR将虚拟内容与现实环境融合，用户仍能感知并与现实世界互动。
2. VR完全以虚拟环境取代现实，用户沉浸在由计算机生成的世界中。
总而言之，MR是虚实结合，VR是完全虚拟。在我深度体验了几个MR游戏和VR游戏之后，我发现了几个很有意思的方向，值得进一步的研究：
1. VR很显然比MR设计的自由度更高。因为受技术局限，MR大多只能识别单个空间（通常是一个房间），场景大小受限的前提下，游戏内容的设计也就限制在这个小小的空间里。且如何在不破坏沉浸感的前提下，把虚拟内容与现实空间进行融合，是一个设计上的挑战。
2. VR理论上可以做到与PC开发游戏同等的自由度，但是沉浸感的上限更高。
3. 然而，实际体验里，VR受硬件和技术限制导致的晕眩，沉重，画面精细度等挑战非常多，经过测试，大多数人持续游玩VR游戏的时长平均在30分钟左右。
4. 也许是由于现实空间透视效果，MR在使用过程中完全没有晕眩，并且在多人协作方向上比VR更容易实现且更有趣。
value.en:
This project was originally an idea I had during my undergraduate studies. At the time, I was asked to design and develop an educational game for my supervisor, and I initially chose virtual reality (VR) as the research direction. During my early research, I found some subtle differences between mixed reality (MR) and virtual reality (VR):

1. MR combines virtual content with the real environment, allowing users to remain aware of and interact with the real world.
2. VR completely replaces the real world with a virtual environment, immersing users in a computer-generated world.

In short, MR combines the real and virtual worlds, while VR is fully virtual. After I had hands-on experience with several MR and VR games, I found several interesting areas that were worth further research:

1. VR clearly offers more freedom in game design than MR. Due to technical limitations, MR can usually only recognize a single space, typically one room. Because the size of the playable space is limited, the game design is also limited to this small space. It is also a design challenge to combine virtual content with the real environment without breaking immersion.
2. In theory, VR can offer a similar level of freedom to developing games for PC, while also providing a higher level of immersion.
3. However, in actual use, VR faces many challenges caused by hardware and technical limitations, such as motion sickness, heavy headsets, and limited visual quality. Based on our testing, most people could play VR games continuously for around 30 minutes on average.
4. Perhaps because users can see the real space around them, MR caused almost no motion sickness during use. It also seemed easier and more interesting to implement for multiplayer cooperation than VR.

value.zh: 在我把这些想法和我的导师进行谈论后，他建议我可以考虑一个方向：即设计并开发一款将MR和VR结合起来的游戏。刚听到这个让我有点不知所措，但仔细想想这么做的人似乎很少，另外，结合我玩游戏的感受，MR某种程度上的确更加友好，似乎比起一开始就被完全虚拟的世界淹没，MR可以成为一种相当合适的预热/新手教学。
value.en: After discussing these ideas with my supervisor, he suggested that I consider one possible direction: designing and developing a game that combines MR and VR. When I first heard this idea, I felt a bit overwhelmed. But after thinking about it carefully, it seemed that very few people had tried this approach. Also, based on my own experience playing games, MR does seem to be more user-friendly in some ways. Rather than immediately being thrown into a fully virtual world, MR could serve as a suitable warm-up or tutorial experience for new players.

value.zh: 因此进入设计阶段后，我几乎第一时间就确认了MR的内容作为前半部分，VR的内容作为后半部分这样的顺序。然后真正的考验是，由于我游戏的主题是一款关于机器学习的预科教育游戏，因此在内容方面需要考虑知识点的循序渐进。其次，如何让MR过渡到VR这个阶段显得很自然？此外，还需要考虑到MR的空间限制。
value.en: Therefore, when I entered the design stage, I almost immediately decided to put the MR content in the first half of the game and the VR content in the second half. The real challenge was that, since the game was designed as a foundation-level educational game about machine learning, I needed to introduce the knowledge step by step. Secondly, I needed to think about how to make the transition from MR to VR feel natural. In addition, I also had to consider the spatial limitations of MR.

value.zh: 我当时工作的环境是一间小办公室，桌面上有一个很大的外接显示屏。在头脑风暴的阶段，我设想了许多诸如MR密室逃脱，寻宝，或者阵地防守，甚至连虚拟桌游的形式我都考虑过。但无一例外的，因为技术限制或者教学性等因素不得不放弃。比如，密室逃脱本身挺有趣的，我的设想是在房间里布置多个同时存在的机关谜题，玩家需要收集并利用现实道具解开虚拟机关，然后逃出房间进入VR异世界。然而，由于我所拥有的设备是META QUEST 3，它并不支持扫描并识别预设物体以外的现实道具，所以这个想法只能遗憾放弃了。
value.en:
At the time, I was working in a small office with a large external monitor on the desk. During the brainstorming stage, I considered many ideas, such as an MR escape room, a treasure hunt, and a base-defense game. I even considered making it a virtual board game. However, I had to give up on all of these ideas due to technical limitations, educational requirements, or other factors.

For example, the escape room idea was quite interesting. My idea was to set up multiple puzzles that existed at the same time in the room. Players would need to collect and use physical objects in the real world to solve virtual puzzles, then escape the room and enter a virtual world in VR. However, the device I had, the Meta Quest 3, could not scan and recognize physical objects other than predefined objects. Because of this limitation, I had to sadly give up on the idea.

value.zh: 结果有一天，我正坐在办公桌前对着我的大显示器苦思冥想，突然灵光一闪：如果把显示器作为挡风玻璃，整个房间当作驾驶室，让玩家可以坐在桌前开飞船怎么样呢？
value.en: Then one day, I was sitting at my desk, staring at the large monitor and trying to figure things out, when I suddenly had an idea: **What if I used the monitor as a windshield and treated the entire room as the cockpit, allowing the player to sit at the desk and pilot a spaceship?**

caption.zh: 虚拟驾驶室 vs. 我的办公桌
caption.en: Virtual cockpit vs. My office desk

value.zh: 这个想法出现后，一切都显得顺理成章起来：一个飞船驾驶室天然符合MR对单一房间空间的需求，并且，利用真实空间的地面和家具（例如我的电脑外接显示器）作为打破完全虚拟化的现实融合因素，不仅不会破坏沉浸感，还会让玩家将现实里的因素加以利用，以获得更好的游戏体验。顺着这个思路，我很快就决定了后续故事发展，玩家将会扮演一名飞船驾驶员，开着飞船进行星际旅程并探索异星球，收集和分析异星球上的数据，为未来人类的栖居地作出贡献。因此，我决定将游戏的后半程：在异星球表面着陆并且收集和处理数据作为VR的部分，一个完全虚拟的环境。
value.en:
Once this idea came to me, everything started to fall into place. A spaceship cockpit naturally fits the single-room space required by MR. Using the real floor and furniture, such as my external computer monitor, as elements that connect the virtual world with reality would not only avoid breaking immersion, but also encourage players to use real-world elements to improve their gameplay experience.

Following this idea, I soon decided on the direction of the story. The player would take on the role of a spaceship pilot, travelling through space and exploring alien planets, collecting and analysing data to help find future habitats for humanity. Therefore, I decided that the second half of the game would take place in VR: the player would land on the surface of alien planets and collect and process data in a completely virtual environment.

value.zh: 在设计游戏的关卡内容时，考虑到这本身是一个面向零基础人群的机器学习概念科普类教育游戏，游戏关卡和任务必须和教学内容高度关联，且以一种参与实践的方式让玩家对这些知识点的掌握随着进程越来越熟练。我设计这款游戏的目标是通过游玩游戏，让玩家获得一种相较于传统课堂效率更高且更具有自驱力积极性的学习方式。因此，通过大量相关领域（主要是XR在教学方面的应用，严肃游戏以及游戏化教育）的文献查阅以及反思后，我将设计方法论总结为如下图所示的框架：
value.en:
When designing the game levels, I considered that this was an educational game aimed at introducing basic machine learning concepts to beginners with no prior knowledge. Therefore, the levels and tasks had to be closely connected to the learning content, while allowing players to learn and gradually become more familiar with these concepts through hands-on practice as they progressed through the game.

My goal was to use gameplay to provide players with a more efficient, self-driven, and engaging way of learning compared with traditional classroom teaching. Therefore, after reviewing and reflecting on a large number of studies in related fields, mainly the use of XR in education, serious games, and gamification in education, I summarised my design methodology into the framework shown in the following figure:

value.en: I then selected appropriate chapters from the learning materials I used during my undergraduate Computer Science studies as reliable sources of information, and designed the following in-game tasks:

value.zh: 在确定了上述的基本框架后，我就开始着手于前期开发工作。受限于时间和工作量，我没有在游戏视觉和美术方面投入精力自己建模和制作动画、特效等，直接从网上的资源商店里下载了免费正版模型。在代码方面，任何一个游戏项目都需要尽可能清晰和便于后续更新的基础，因此，我采用了设计模式来构建核心并确保游戏的可拓展性、可维护性和模块化。如下图所示，我利用Singleton和State模式等设计模式来管理游戏状态和场景，该架构围绕GameManager，SceneManager，TaskManager和UIManager等核心组件，确保以有序方式处理游戏流程、状态转换和交互。
value.en:
After establishing the basic framework above, I began the early development work. Due to time and workload constraints, I did not spend much effort on creating the game's visuals and art myself, such as modelling, animations, or visual effects. Instead, I downloaded free and legally licensed models from online asset stores.

On the programming side, every game project needs a clear foundation that is easy to update and maintain. Therefore, I used design patterns to build the core systems and ensure the game's scalability, maintainability, and modularity. As shown in the figure below, I used design patterns such as the Singleton and State patterns to manage the game states and scenes. The architecture is built around core components such as the GameManager, SceneManager, TaskManager, and UIManager, ensuring that the game flow, state transitions, and interactions are handled in an organised way.

value.zh: 我向来很乐意在游戏中探索多样化的交互方式。这个项目也不例外。我尝试在游戏的不同阶段整合了多种交互方法，例如手势识别、凝视识别、控制器输入以及语音识别（使用了自定义的AI关键词模型）。玩家将利用合理的交互方式在游戏里驾驶飞船、操纵武器、虚拟界面交互以及物品收集。之所以整合这些交互方式不仅仅是出于我的实验兴趣，更多是我在过往使用VR设备的经验中发现，很多初次使用头戴式VR设备的用户变得熟练使用控制器进行游戏并不容易，因此我在设计交互方法时考虑到更符合人类直觉的自然交互方式，例如抓取物品和触屏控制界面我选取了手势交互，经过后续的用户测试验证，大部分的用户对于这种方式很快就适应并且熟练使用。而对于一些特定的场景，例如游戏中有一关需要玩家使用粒子发射器进行射击，对于这部分我则引入了控制器，并将它们设置为可以与手势兼容的模式，因为使用真实的控制抓握并扣动扳机进行射击更符合人的直觉。
value.en:
I have always enjoyed exploring different types of interaction in games. This project was no exception. I tried to integrate several interaction methods at different stages of the game, including gesture recognition, gaze tracking, controller input, and voice recognition using a custom AI keyword model. Players would use different interaction methods to pilot the spaceship, operate weapons, interact with virtual interfaces, and collect items.

The reason I integrated these interaction methods was not only because of my interest in experimentation. Based on my previous experience using VR devices, I found that many first-time VR users have difficulty becoming familiar with controllers. Therefore, when designing the interactions, I also considered more intuitive and natural ways of interacting. For example, I chose gesture-based interaction for tasks such as grabbing objects and using touchscreen-like interfaces. Later user testing showed that most users quickly adapted to and became comfortable with this method.

For specific situations, however, I chose different interaction methods. For example, one level requires the player to use a particle blaster to shoot targets. For this part, I introduced controllers and made them compatible with gesture-based interactions. Using a physical controller to grip the weapon and pull the trigger feels more natural and intuitive for shooting.

value.zh: 除此之外，对于游戏中大部分需要简单文字说明的道具和虚拟物品，我为它们制作了一种通过检测凝视激活的UI面板，这样有效降低了场景内同时存在过多文本信息量可能带来的认知负担——尤其是在VR环境中。而对于后半部分的机器人助手，我给它加入了可以用语音输入进行简单交流的功能，不过在实际用户测试中，真正使用这一功能的用户并不多，我认为一部分原因可能来自于这个检测语音输入的模块有比较明显的延迟而带来了不好的用户体验，因此在最终版本中这一功能被废除了，后续使用类似的功能也需要考虑到这一点。
value.en:
In addition, for most objects and virtual items in the game that required simple text descriptions, I created UI panels that were activated when the player looked at them. This helped reduce the cognitive load caused by having too much text displayed in the scene at the same time, especially in a VR environment.

For the robot assistant in the second half of the game, I also added a voice input feature that allowed players to have simple conversations with it. However, during the user testing, not many users actually used this feature. I think one possible reason was the noticeable delay in the voice input detection module, which led to a poor user experience. Therefore, this feature was removed from the final version, and this is also something that should be considered when implementing similar features in future projects.
